carmen: Quick FYI: noticed inconsistent fncall outputs across SDKs when using json mode + union schemas. Sampleapp expects object|array but Node returns an empty array sometimes.

lee: Can you paste a tiny repro? Which SDK versions?

carmen: Repro: call client.call with mode:'json' and jsonSchema that allows either object or array of objects. On Node v1.8.x I sometimes see `[]` returned and our validator treats that as success then downstream code fails. Rust SDK (internal) returns `null` in the same path; Python returns `{}`.

priya: That variance is bad. Is this tied to retries or auth/backoff?

carmen: Correlation with mid-stream retry and fncall completion - if a 502 happens then retry merges frames weirdly. I have a small harness that flips a 502 at token 2 and forces a retry; then Node returns `[]`.

ash: Hypothesis: streaming parser's merge step uses an accumulator array and when the final value is an empty object it's serialized as empty array in one code path. We'll audit the join+parse logic.

dev-bot: :warning: sampleapp/parse-fuzz detected 5 anomalies in last 2h

lee: Short-term fix: sampleapp should defensively handle `[]` when schema allows object by treating single-element arrays as element or empty-array -> null safe. Add a validation helper: `normalizeFncallOutput(schema, val)` and lint for strict jsonMode usage in samplekits.

priya: I'll open a PR in node-sdk with a minimal normalization for union schemas: coerce single-element arrays -> element, coerce empty-array -> null only when schema permits null. We'll log metric `jsonmode.union_coerce` so we can assess impact.

ash: Also add a unit test that simulates mid-stream 502 + retry to catch the merge behavior. And add an integration test against the sampleapp harness.

support-bot: :memo: Support blurb draft: "If you see empty-array outputs from jsonMode fncall, upgrade to node-sdk patch that normalizes union outputs or apply the sampleapp normalize helper. Contact eng-devex if you need staging repro access."

carmen: Filing issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/issues/1401 with repro and patch suggestion.

lee: Long-term: standardize SDK behavior (Node/Python/Rust) to strictly validate against declared schema and return a typed error instead of silent coercions. We'll discuss RFC next sprint. For now, prioritize small safe coercions + metrics.

priya: PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/852 - adds normalize helper + tests. ETA tomorrow morning.

carmen: Thx. If anyone wants to run the harness I can share the flaky binary in staging.

(ends)
